title: Producer-step orbit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine, let $C,e$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $t$ be a natural number. Iterating the producer step $t$ times from the retained state encoding $x$, time zero, and an empty table yields the retained state encoding $x$, time $t$, and the table of the first $t$ visit rows for $M,C,e,x$.
replaced: For every source machine, parameters, instance $x$, and count $t$, iterating the producer step $t$ times from the empty retained state yields the retained state at time $t$ holding exactly the ordered table of the first $t$ visit rows.
